observed sequences ($S, {\it R }$) takes the form
(\cite{Saul},\cite{MacKay})

\begin{equation} Pr({\it R },S)= A \exp \left( J \sum_{i=1}^{N-1} s_{i+1} s_i + K

\begin{equation} A_0 = \frac{1}{2} \left( e^J + e^{-J} \right)^{-(N-1)} \qquad
\qquad A_1 = \left( e^K + e^{-K} \right)^{-N}  \end{equation}
